نزدقم (form VIII)
# نَزْدَقِمُ (nazdaqimu) /naz.da.qi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# نُزْدَقَمُ (nuzdaqamu) /nuz.da.qa.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# نَزْدَقِمَ (nazdaqima) /naz.da.qi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# نُزْدَقَمَ (nuzdaqama) /nuz.da.qa.ma/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
